heading: Today
text: Sun mixing with clouds south.  Any breaks of sun north giving way to clouds, with scattered showers in the St. Lawrence Valley, then just a few stray showers in the rest of Quebec, south to the Adirondacks and Rt. 2.  Highs in the mid 50s to mid 60s north to south.  Light winds becoming south to southwest near 10 mph, gusting to 20 near Lake Champlain, then lighter midday, swinging into the northwest in the afternoon.

heading: Tonight
text: Gradual clearing from north to south.  Much cooler for northern areas.  Lows in the 20s to near 30 north, 30 to 35 south.  Winds shifting to the northwest, gradually becoming north near 10 mph, gusting to 20 mph through the Champlain Valley.

heading: Tuesday
text: Mostly sunny and much cooler.  Highs in the 40s north, 50 to 55 south.  Winds north 5 to 15 mph.
